latest_release.name: v4.0.542
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed

- [`@remotion/lambda-client`: Add `renderMediaOnLambdaAndStream()` and `renderFramesOnLambdaAndStream()`](https://remotion.dev/docs/lambda/rendermediaonlambdaandstream) by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12851
- [`@remotion/lambda`: Add `chunks` to `renderMediaOnLambda()` and `--chunks` to `npx remotion lambda render`](https://remotion.dev/docs/options/chunks) by @TimbuckTato in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12879
- [`@remotion/studio`: Add OpenTimelineIO import](https://remotion.dev/docs/codemods/generate-open-timeline-composition) by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12580
- [`@remotion/studio`: Add high contrast mode](https://remotion.dev/docs/options/high-contrast) by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12969
- [`@remotion/effects`: Add `magnify()` for enlarging image regions](https://remotion.dev/docs/effects/magnify) by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12991
- [`@remotion/effects`: Add `lightning()` for branching lightning bolts](https://remotion.dev/docs/effects/lightning) by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13051
- [`@remotion/cli`: Add `remotion elements use` command](https://remotion.dev/docs/cli/elements/use) by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13000
- `@remotion/studio-server`: Reduce latency for edits by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13087
- `remotion`: Fix missing images and videos inside `<HtmlInCanvas>` by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12971
- `remotion`: Fix playback stuttering when resizing `<HtmlInCanvas>` by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13079
- `remotion`: Fix `<Sequence>` inside `<ThreeCanvas>` crashing in Studio by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12979
- `remotion`: Clarify that unavailable HTML-in-canvas support refers to nested support by @amir-rezaei in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12981
- `remotion`: Skip image loading during audio-only rendering by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12998
- `remotion`: Return `true` from `useAudioEnabled()` during server-side rendering by @DeryFerd in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13045
- `remotion`: Remove premount controls from default component schemas by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13083
- `@remotion/bundler`: Fix EPERM when copying Windows directory junctions by @z22115554 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13060
- `@remotion/cloudrun`: Update Google Cloud Storage to 7.21.0 by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12938
- `@remotion/codemods`: Wrap added imports that exceed printWidth by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13008
- `@remotion/codemods`: Fix default import when inserting lazy compositions with named exports by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13096
- `create-video`: Add `--skills` flag for non-interactive skill installation by @DeryFerd in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12963
- `@remotion/eslint-plugin`: Flag absolute Windows paths with any drive letter or a UNC prefix by @DeryFerd in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13028
- `@remotion/eslint-plugin`: Check `srcSet` in the `no-string-assets` rule by @DeryFerd in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13046
- `@remotion/eslint-plugin`: Check `staticFile()` template literal arguments by @DeryFerd in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13068
- `@remotion/lambda`: Reduce progress update overhead by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13003
- `@remotion/lambda-go`: Surface Lambda function errors in render and progress invocations by @DeryFerd in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/13064
- `@remotion/lambda-php`: Type

detail.readme: - **Make videos agentically**: Turn your idea into a video using your agent. - **Make videos interactively**: Edit and animate like in a regular video editor. - **Make videos programmatically**: Leverage web technology and own your video as code. ## Video Automation - **Design systems**: Create a library of animated assets for your organization. - **Batch rendering**: Render millions of videos on your own infrastructure. - **Applications**: Publish a simple tool or a complex video editor. ## Get started If you already have Node.JS installed, type ```console npx create-video@latest ``` to get started. Otherwise, read the [installation page](https://www.remotion.dev/docs/) in the documentation. ## Discover Remotion Remotion is extensively documented over 1,200 pages. - Get Started - [Installation](https://remotion.dev/docs) -
